videos.title: Alex Hormozi: If I Started Today, This Is What I Would Do
videos.description:
You already know what to do. You just don't know what order to do it in.

In this clip, Alex Hormozi and Jay Shetty break down why almost everyone gets the sequence of making money backwards, and why investing is the last thing you do, not the first.

Alex explains the five stages every person goes through when they try to build an income, why most people spend five to seven years reliving the same thirty days, and the four steps that turn an idea into a real business by tomorrow. He also names the piece of advice he thinks does the most damage to people's finances, and it's the one you've heard at every graduation you've ever sat through.

Learn about the offer that costs you nothing to make, why working for free is the fastest way to start earning, and the single emotion Alex says is behind more failure than any other.

JAY'S DAILY WISDOM DELIVERED STRAIGHT TO YOUR INBOX
Join 900,000+ readers discovering how small daily shifts create big life change with my free newsletter. Subscribe https://news.jayshetty.me/subscribe

Chapters
0:00 — Getting clear on what actions actually matter
1:20 — The number one thing people get backwards
2:41 — Why your friends never got rich off crypto
3:41 — The something for nothing fallacy
5:24 — Reliving the same 30 days for seven years
5:47 — The five stages of every new entrepreneur
7:48 — Start with skills, not with money
8:43 — Passion, profession and pain
9:41 — Why "follow your passion" is the worst advice
12:58 — Believing too much in the idea
13:41 — Four steps to a business by tomorrow
14:14 — The text to send your 400 contacts
16:11 — Why working for free isn't working for free
17:51 — The number you should be chasing instead
19:41 — Same condition, new behavior
20:07 — The one emotion behind most failure
21:14 — Playing the worst case all the way out
22:49 — Alex on Final Five
